snippet.title: Gooey – Wishlist Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689150/Gooey/

A fast, physics-driven platformer inspired by Celeste, Super Meat Boy, and Mario Maker.
Grapple, swing, and launch through pipe networks, pulley belts, and electric hazards.
Collect the L, A, B letters and reach the beacon!
Build and share levels on Steam Workshop.

Built from scratch by two veteran devs using our own custom engine!

Wishlist now to support us!

#gooey #indiegame  #platformer #steamwishlist  #gameDev #indiedev #physicsplatformer #leveleditor
